name: turkey-company-formation-entity-choice-2
description: Entity choice for a business, and especially a foreign investor, setting up in Turkey (Türkiye) for tax year 2026: limited company, joint stock company, branch or liaison office of a foreign company. From the Turkish Commercial Code No. 6102 and the Foreign Direct Investment Law No. 4875. Covers who may form each vehicle, liability, the TRY 50,000 and TRY 250,000 minimum capital (TRY 500,000 for a non-public registered-capital joint stock company), when capital is paid, the steps through MERSIS, the 0.04% Competition Authority share, 2026 registry fees, the 2026 corporate tax return dates, and the deadline for existing companies to raise their capital, now 31 December 2027. Trigger phrases: which company form in Turkey, branch or subsidiary Turkey, liaison office Turkey, foreign investor company Turkey, şube mi şirket mi. Out of scope: tr-company-formation (the same rules in short form), tr-corporate-income-tax, turkey-vat, tr-payroll-social, tr-tax-overview.
